verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own `edge0 serve` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint on localhost. In principle a coding agent that speaks the OpenAI API could use it as its model backend. However, the evidence never documents connecting a coding agent, tool/function calling, or streaming behavior needed for agentic coding workflows. Missing for 10: documented coding-agent integration examples, tool/function-calling support, streaming and agent-compatibility details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect a coding agent to this product as a working backend
